title: Map of my places
summary: A map of your favourite places, kept in a table, with a message when a marker is tapped.
done: Your map reads its markers from a table: add a row, a marker appears. Try [center … on my position] to find yourself on the map.

welcome.text: A **Map** is already on the screen. We will put your favourite places on it, kept in a table.

columns.text: It needs three columns: “Name” (text), “Latitude” and “Longitude” (of type **Number**).

rows.text: Add at least two places. For example Eiffel Tower: 48.8584, 2.2945; Toulouse Capitole: 43.6045, 1.4440.
rows.hint: To find the coordinates of a place, look it up on openstreetmap.org: they show in the address of the page.

bind.text: Select the **Map** and, in **source (table)**, choose “Places”. Check that Latitude, Longitude and Title point to the right columns.

on-marker.text: Add [when a marker of {{Map}} is tapped] and put [show a short message …] inside, with the [event value title].

run.text: In the preview, tap a marker on the map: its name shows up.
